verdicts.evidence: Trefis 2026-09-18新闻：'Qualcomm (QCOM) told investors in its fiscal Q3 2026 call that its share of Apple's recent iPhone launch would be materially lower than its prior estimate of 20%'。行情数据显示营收增速-4.0%、净利增速-23.0%。
行情数据显示预期PE 17.42倍。Trefis 2026-09-18新闻：'management raised its non-handset revenue target for fiscal 2029 to $40 billion—nearly doubling its prior $22 billion'。

Stocktwits 2026-09-17报道：'Trump-Xi Dinner Next Week Brings AI Titans To The Table — OpenAI, NVDA, and QCOM CEOs To Attend, Says Report'，'Sam Altman, Jensen Huang and Cristiano Amon are reportedly expected at the September 24 summit as AI safety, development standards and chip access emerge as potential discussion points.'

Trefis 2026-09-18新闻：'Qualcomm (QCOM) told investors in its fiscal Q3 2026 call that its share of Apple's recent iPhone launch would be materially lower than its prior estimate of 20%'，这反映了Apple减少芯片采购。
这是对未来的预期判断，不涉及可核对的历史事实。虽然数据显示非手机业务目标为2029年$40B，但'增长不及预期'是主观展望。
这是对地缘政治风险的主观判断和展望，虽然Stocktwits报道提到Trump-Xi峰会和芯片访问讨论，但'可能影响'是推测性的因果关系，不是已发生的事实。
行情数据显示：20日年化波动率% 37.44，beta 1.68。
这是对竞争格局的主观判断。虽然新闻提到ARM和NVIDIA在AI芯片领域的活动（ARM 2026-09-18新闻、NVIDIA 2026-09-18新闻），但'竞争加剧'是定性评价，不是可量化的事实。
